bridges.description: Access to credential material may yield possession of the represented credential.
Possession of a credential may enable access as its represented identity when an identity relation exists.
Internal network reach can satisfy reachability of an internal service entrypoint.
Code execution in a process may grant the process identity and its scopes.
Object write may alter privileged workflow state.
Prompt injection may control tool arguments only when a tool-selection relation exists.
Tool-argument control may lead to a side effect only when the tool capability and identity are modeled.
Cross-tenant object access may constitute a confidentiality or integrity impact.
Persistence write may lead to future execution only when an autoload relation exists.
